name: LM317
description: Adjustable three-terminal positive linear regulator. Output set by two resistors; maintains 1.25V between OUT and ADJ. Can also serve as a constant-current source. TO-220 pin order is ADJ-OUT-IN.

pins.name: ADJUST
pins.description: adjustment/feedback pin, sets output via resistor divider

TO-220.notes: metal tab is connected to OUT (pin 2); isolate it from grounded heatsinks.

typical_application: Vout = 1.25 * (1 + R2/R1). Use R1=240 ohm (OUT to ADJ) and R2 (ADJ to GND) to set voltage. Add a 10uF cap on ADJ for ripple rejection and protection diodes on big outputs.
gotchas: the TAB is OUT, not ground; an LM317 bolted bare to a grounded heatsink shorts the output
needs a minimum load (~10mA) to regulate; the divider current usually satisfies this
about 3V dropout: input must stay at least ~3V above output
add a protection diode from OUT to IN on high-capacitance outputs to prevent reverse discharge
